name: Swiftspeed – Convert your WordPress site and Blog to Native Android, iOS and PWA Apps
author: swiftspeed

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress website into real native Android and iOS mobile apps, plus an installable PWA, without writing a single line of code.

Swiftspeed empowers bloggers, publishers, businesses, freelancers, and agencies to launch premium native mobile apps for both Android and iOS in minutes. Connect your site once and Swiftspeed builds your app automatically: your posts, pages, categories, menus, and media sync in real time, so your website becomes a fully functional mobile app that is customizable and ready to publish to the app stores.

In minutes, not months. No coding. No delays. No separate codebase to maintain. Everything stays inside your WordPress dashboard.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Click Connect to Swiftspeed and pair your site
  3. Personalize your app’s design, colors, icon, and layout
  4. Hit sync and your posts and categories appear instantly in the live app preview
  5. Publish your PWA today, then download ready-to-publish builds for Google Play and the Apple App Store

Build, preview, and publish your app in real time.

Why choose Swiftspeed

Swiftspeed makes mobile app development accessible to everyone: business owners, bloggers, publishers, freelancers, and agencies. With true native technology, real-time sync, and deep WordPress integration, you deliver a seamless, high-performance app experience your audience will actually want to install.

Key features

Native Android and iOS apps
Create real native apps for both platforms. Offer an authentic, fast, high-performance experience, not just a web view wrapper.

Real-time website to app sync
Every change you publish on your WordPress site appears instantly in your app, automatically. Edit a post, add a category, update a menu, your app stays in step.

Deep WordPress integration
– Sync WordPress posts, pages, and custom post types automatically
– Display categories, tags, and taxonomies natively in your app
– Import your existing menus or build new app navigation
– Featured images, galleries, and media carried through automatically
– Automatic updates whenever you edit or publish new content

No-code app builder
Build and customize your app with an intuitive visual interface. Personalize colors, icons, screens, fonts, and menus, all without touching code.

AI-assisted setup
Tell the AI builder what your site is about (“a travel blog”, “a local news site”) and it picks a theme, generates your cover art, writes your screen copy, and curates your layout. Or design every detail yourself.

Progressive Web App (PWA)
Give visitors an installable app experience straight from the browser: add to home screen on iOS, Android, and desktop, full-screen launch, custom splash screen, offline caching, and web push.

Push notifications
Re-engage your audience and bring them back with native and web push notifications.

Customizable design
Design your app icon, launch screen, login pages, themes, and full navigation structure to match your brand.

Multilingual and CMS support
Enable multiple languages, add unlimited CMS pages, and sync all custom post types and taxonomies.

Analytics and insights
Track app traffic, installs, and user engagement from your Swiftspeed dashboard.

Instant delivery and easy publishing
Preview your app instantly on Android and iOS, then download production builds and publish directly to Google Play and the App Store.

Benefits

  • Save time: Build apps in minutes, not months.
  • Save cost: Skip expensive agencies and long development cycles.
  • Stay synced: Keep your website and app content unified automatically.
  • Grow your audience: Increase engagement and loyalty with your own branded mobile app and push notifications.

Perfect for

  • Bloggers and publishers
  • News, magazine, and content sites
  • Businesses going mobile
  • Membership, LMS, and community sites
  • Agencies and freelancers building apps for clients
  • Any WordPress website that wants its own app

Links and resources

WordPress App Builder

Website to App Converter

External services

This plugin connects to Swiftspeed (https://swiftspeed.app) to build and run your mobile app. Swiftspeed is the service that turns your site into a PWA and into real native apps you can publish (Android APK and AAB, plus an iOS build for the App Store). Your app, settings, and support messages live on swiftspeed.app, and the plugin is the link between your WordPress site and that service.

The plugin contacts swiftspeed.app in these cases:

  • When you connect. The plugin sends your site address, site name, and tagline to Swiftspeed so it can build your app. Your published posts and categories are read so they can appear in the app. The plugin does not create any WordPress users or passwords.
  • While you customize the app. When you change the design, colors, or app name, build an app, manage your plan, or open a support ticket, those choices are sent to Swiftspeed to apply them. This only happens when you take an action in the plugin.
  • For the live preview. The plugin shows a preview of your app loaded from Swiftspeed, and the Swiftspeed logo in the plugin header.
  • When you disconnect or delete the plugin. The plugin lets Swiftspeed know and clears its local settings. Your Swiftspeed account and content stay on swiftspeed.app.

No data is sent to swiftspeed.app unless you install the plugin and start the connect flow. The plugin does not send data to any other third party.

  • Terms of Service: https://swiftspeed.app/terms-of-services
  • Privacy Policy: https://swiftspeed.app/privacy-policies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Website to App in your admin menu
  4. Click Connect to Swiftspeed and follow the popup to sign in or create your account
  5. Customize your design and publish from the plugin tabs
sections.faq:
Do I need to write any code?

No. Swiftspeed is a fully no-code app builder. You connect your site, customize visually, and publish. No development experience required.

How does my content get into the app?

Automatically. Once connected, your posts, pages, categories, and media sync in real time. Publish or edit on your website and your app updates to match, with no manual export.

Do I need a Swiftspeed account?

Yes. Creating one takes about 60 seconds during the Connect flow. The plugin bridges your WordPress site to swiftspeed.app, where the app is built. See the “External services” section above for what data is sent.

Do I need an Apple Developer or Google Play account?

Only when you are ready to publish to the stores. The PWA installs straight from the browser with no developer account at all. For native store publishing, you use a Google Play and Apple Developer account, the standard requirement for every app on those stores.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. The app pulls your posts, pages, categories, and featured images directly, so it works no matter which WordPress theme your site uses.

Does it work for non-WordPress websites?

Yes. The “Website to App” mode can wrap any website into a native shell with PWA, push, and custom branding. The full real-time content sync applies when the plugin is installed on a WordPress site.

Can I disconnect anytime?

Yes. Click Disconnect and the link is removed cleanly. Your WordPress site and content stay exactly as they were, with nothing left behind.
